title: Members of the Holmes Band of Lutcher photo
summary: Joseph and the interviewers identify players in a photo of the Holmes Band: the one-handed bass drummer John Porter, Floyd Jackson, Davy Jones, Henry Sawyer, Dennis Harris, and cornetists Professor Holmes and Joe Poehler.
